answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 68 identities per epoch. Audits are published in ember, queued in inlet, and juniper publishes the wait time. A farm of 221 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3663 identities would post 4997 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
